name: unit_name
comment: Empty string is a valid identifier value (COALESCE default); it denotes a plant with no sub-unit distinction

name: time_code
doc: Time code (1-48; START-time based; same convention as JEPX)
comment: Derived from the 48 timeslot column's position in the bronze schema CSV

name: delivery_datetime
doc: Delivery datetime derived from target_date and time_code

name: generation_kwh
doc: Power generation actuals for this 30-minute slot (kWh)
comment: Unpivoted from one of the 48 timeslot columns

name: power_generation_method_and_fuel_type
doc: Power generation method and fuel type

name: updated_datetime
doc: Updated datetime of the OCCTO publication used to select the latest revision
